exclusions.reason: The official university pages confirm international-student activity and scholarship-host status, but the current official source examined did not expose a machine-verifiable individual-application program catalogue. No third-party program claims were emitted.
Domestic admissions catalogues, domestic degree-authorisation lists, third-party aggregators, inferred eligibility, expired deadlines presented as open, and image-only dynamic values were excluded.
